time: built by build-packet.py from the copied raw wall-clock.jsonl files
note: Exact surviving reaction rows from all five testers and ten sessions, kept literally, not a reconstructed producer diary. Every raw reaction is kept, including ones the report omits, shortens or respells, ones with an escaped or dropped apostrophe, and ones attached to a failed (error) tap. Each row keeps every original key plus rowIndex (1-based line of wall-clock.jsonl), containsBackslash and contextBefore (the previous raw row). Rows with no reaction text (opens, automatic shots, some waits) are counted in rows but not listed. reactionsNotLiterallyInReport counts reactions whose exact text is not a substring of that tester's report.md. Nia's report section 3 is a reconstruction by the producer: her original reactions are only in these rows and in nia/raw-driver-reactions.json, never promoted into the report diary. Report memories and estimates stay separate; a report line is not substituted for a raw row.
